objective: replace the fixed oldest prepared K6 fusion seed with the prepared task having the largest standalone eight-bank issue-cycle score, while preserving the canonical M53 parent DAG and the existing greedy group completion

seed_contract.oldest_reproduction: minimum prepared task index, exactly M89 K6
seed_contract.standalone_bank_issue_cycles: maximum popcount among the eight fixed 32-source bank masks
seed_contract.group_completion: unchanged M45 greedy selection maximizing saved source-bank issue cycles until K6 or prepared exhaustion
seed_contract.parent_choice: unchanged canonical M53 adaptive temporal parent
seed_contract.selector_structure: one 16-entry compare tree over a six-bit score plus existing task-order tie break

negative_control_policy.purpose: test whether merely changing seed order explains the result; it cannot replace the frozen critical-first primary

kill_conditions: oldest policy fails exact M89 K6 reproduction
critical-first fails any arithmetic, dependency, occupancy, p95 or per-sample gate
critical-first source or integrated improvement is below 0.5 percent
a promotion requires changing parent choice, K6 group completion, FIFO depth, source-bank mapping or vector storage
sparse-first outperforms critical-first; in that case the frozen critical-first hypothesis is rejected rather than retuned

admitted_after_validation: exact frozen-cohort transaction-model comparison against M89 K6
critical-first seed opportunity with a bounded metadata selector
forbidden: RTL correctness, selector II/latency feasibility or synthesized PPA
equal-area, accuracy, full-network, system, DATE headline or best-paper claim
